name: bc-word-layout
description: Author, validate and preview Business Central Word report layouts with AI agents: the bc-word-layout MCP server (28 deterministic tools) plus four skills - al-word-layout teaches the intended inspect -> edit -> validate -> preview workflow, al-word-layout-design teaches what a from-scratch layout should look like (archetype skeletons and observed BC document conventions), al-word-layout-from-design turns a finished Word design plus the report's empty layout into a bound layout, and al-word-layout-composite covers composable layouts (body, header/footer and theme).
